title: EFF argues tech companies are trying to redefine privacy again
summary: The Electronic Frontier Foundation published a deeplink on November 14, 2026 arguing that technology companies are once again attempting to shift the entire concept of privacy. The piece is policy advocacy and analysis rather than a report of a shipped product, court ruling, or measured technical result, and the supplied material does not include the article&\#x27;s full text or the specific companies and proposals it names. Hacker News readers picked up the argument chiefly through the case of AI meeting notetakers, which the discussion treated as an example of surveillance becoming a workplace default.

references.title: Tech Companies Are Trying to Shift the Concept of Privacy (Again)
